# Video Automation

## Procedure
Check ffmpeg/ffprobe; use rights-cleared assets; optionally Piper/Whisper/Remotion when installed; retain project source, captions and manifest; verify rendered output.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
